title: Science Source Ledger
purpose: Primary and high-quality scientific sources used to extend Tim Dooley / Potato of Life scientific comparisons without converting analogy into empirical proof.

archive_rule: Every scientific equation placed beside Potatoverse concepts must identify whether it is Tim-originated, conversation-developed, later archive formalization, established external science, or historical-symbolic comparison. External sources support the external science only, not the spiritual or astrological claim mapped onto it.
